title: fix: remove JavaScript source accidentally rendered below approval dashboard
purpose: 開発資産の把握・引継ぎ・レビューを支援する変更
purpose_basis: 変更パスと表題による分類（意味の確定には原文を確認）
body: The published approval dashboard included a second `</script></body></html>` and ~4.7 KB of duplicate JavaScript text after the real HTML document, which appeared as raw source in Safari. Remove everything after the first closing HTML document. Strengthen CI assertions to detect an extra closing script tag or leaked text after `</html>`. No app/DB/Push changes.
head: 5733e11fb8e95c6a15d4b939fbc7c9e5f583262e
main_status: mainに祖先コミットとして存在（機能受入・本番は別）

code_facts.kind: テストの期待値・条件
code_facts.expression: assert html.count("<script>") == 1 and html.count("</script>") == 1, "Script tags must be balanced and unique"

code_facts.kind: テストの期待値・条件
code_facts.expression: assert html.rstrip().endswith("</script></body></html>"), "No content may leak after the closing HTML"

source.coverage: 対象外（秘密情報候補／非テキスト）

files.patch:
diff --git a/scripts/check_approval_dashboard.py b/scripts/check_approval_dashboard.py
index 28274ec..afb65c3 100644
--- a/scripts/check_approval_dashboard.py
+++ b/scripts/check_approval_dashboard.py
@@ -25,6 +25,8 @@ html = Path("docs/approval-dashboard/index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
 parser = Scripts()
 parser.feed(html)
 assert len(parser.scripts) == 1, "Exactly one inline script expected"
+assert html.count("<script>") == 1 and html.count("</script>") == 1, "Script tags must be balanced and unique"
+assert html.rstrip().endswith("</script></body></html>"), "No content may leak after the closing HTML"
 assert "https://api.github.com/" in html
 assert "noopener noreferrer" in html
 assert "localStorage" not in html and "access_token" not in html
files.patch_coverage: git merge-baseから対象HEADへの差分（最大60000文字）
